intro.title: Styled Component Pattern
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user profile card using the Styled Component pattern to style your React components. You will learn how to write CSS directly within your JavaScript files using the styled-components library, creating reusable and scoped styles. The main technologies involved are React, JavaScript (JSX), and the styled-components package. This approach helps keep your styles modular and tied to specific components, making your code easier to maintain and understand.
intro.usecase: The Styled Component pattern is widely used in modern React applications to create reusable, self-contained UI components with encapsulated styles. You'll see this pattern in design systems for consistent buttons, form inputs, and navigation menus across entire applications. Product teams use it for building interactive dashboards with themed panels, modals, and data visualization widgets that maintain consistent styling. This approach is particularly valuable when creating complex UI libraries or maintaining large-scale applications where visual consistency and component isolation are critical.
